React + Vite client for grandstack-server: faceted movie and people search, compare, graph views, and create/edit/delete. urql with typed operations from GraphQL Code Generator. Read [docs/architecture.md](/docs/grandstack-web/architecture/) first, then [docs/recipes.md](/docs/grandstack-web/recipes/) for the change you are making.

## Commands
- Whole stack: `cd ../grandstack && docker compose up --build` (web http://localhost:3000, GraphQL http://localhost:4000/graphql).
- Dev server: `npm ci && npm run dev` (server must be running; `VITE_GRAPHQL_URL` changes the endpoint).
- After changing any GraphQL document or the server schema: `npm run codegen` (needs the server running), commit `src/graphql/generated/`.
- Before you finish: `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run docs:check`. With a freshly seeded stack also `npm run e2e`.

## Rules that are easy to get wrong
- **Build on the blocks; do not make a silo.** A new repository or setup must be made from what GRANDstack already provides (the `grandstack-server` image and its models, the `grandstack-federation` gateway, `grandstack-auth`, `grandstack-agents`, compose overlays in the `grandstack` repository), and improve a block when it falls short rather than copying or working around it. Read [building on GRANDstack](/docs/grandstack/building-on-grandstack/) before creating a repository, a compose file, a server, a gateway or a docs structure. Providing building blocks that people shape into their own solution is a goal of the project.
- Write operations with `graphql()` from `src/graphql/generated`; never edit that folder by hand. Operation names must be unique across the app.
- Filters live in the URL ([docs/architecture.md](/docs/grandstack-web/architecture/#data-flow)). Text inputs that write to the URL need local state plus a debounce.
- Clearing filters: add new fields to `emptyFilters` with an explicit `undefined`, or `{ ...filters, ...emptyFilters }` will not clear them.
- Relationship edits are diffs (`buildUpdateInput` in `src/forms/model.ts`), never "disconnect all, then connect". Scalar updates are `{ set: value }`.
- Title search is case-sensitive in the API; `buildWhere` matches several casings.
- Do **not** add `@neo4j-ndl/*` (GPL-3.0; this repo is Apache-2.0). The Needle-style tokens are approximations. See [docs/customising.md](/docs/grandstack-web/customising/#about-needle).
- `VITE_GRAPHQL_URL` is fixed at build time and must be reachable from the browser. The compare tray is hidden on form pages on purpose.
- No authentication: edit screens show a banner and deletes ask for confirmation. Do not expose the app publicly.
- Keep `graphql` on 16.x to match the server. Pin exact dependency versions.
- New code files need the copyright header (two lines: `Copyright (c) "Neo4j"` and `Neo4j Sweden AB [http://neo4j.com]`, in the file's comment syntax). Run `node ../grandstack/scripts/add-headers.mjs` (or `node ../.github/scripts/headers.mjs --root .` for one repository) to add it; `--check` lists what is missing. Generated files are exempt.

## Keep the docs true
When you change behaviour, update the matching doc in the same change (routes and folder map in `docs/architecture.md`, feature behaviour in `docs/features.md`, new gotchas here or in `docs/testing.md`). `npm run docs:check` fails on a broken relative link. Diagrams are SVG files in `docs/diagrams/`: edit the SVG and its numbered legend together when behaviour changes; `npm run docs:check` fails on a missing alt text, unsafe SVG content, or legend numbers that do not match the callouts drawn.
- Releases use the **release-cut** workflow (Actions tab), which sets the version in every `package.json`, tags and publishes. Do not bump versions or push tags by hand; see `grandstack/docs/releasing.md`.
- Base images in Dockerfiles and compose files are pinned to an exact version **and** a digest (`image:1.2.3@sha256:...`), never a floating tag such as `latest` or `24-slim`, so a rebuilt image cannot silently change or be swapped. Dependabot proposes updates to both; take them through a pull request that passes CI. To pin a new image, look up the digest of the multi-arch index (not of one platform).
